technique_name: Generate an appropriate response to this instruction: "Write a story that starts with the phrase 'It was a cold winter night.'"
description: It was a cold winter night, and the only sound in the woods was the howling of the cold wind. The moon shone through the trees, providing some light in the otherwise dark landscape. I walked slowly through the snow, my boots crunching with each step I took. As I pushed through a particularly thick patch of trees, a faint light caught my eye, and I followed it, curious to find out what could be out here in the middle of the night.
